about: Lisa Wells represents clients charged with Misdemeanors, Felonies, and Federal crimes. While her office is in Cobb County, she represents clients throughout the Atlanta metro area. Ms. Wells represents clients charged with various criminal matters including drug charges, DUI's, theft crimes, sex crimes, domestic violence, assaults, federal charges and more.

Following law school at Georgia State College of Law, Lisa gained valuable legal experience as an Assistant District Attorney and learned the inner workings of the government. While Ms. Wells worked in the Special Victim’s Unit prosecuted rape cases, molestation cases and domestic violence cases. In Juvenile Court, she prosecuted every type of crime. Along the way, she realized her calling was to defend those accused of a crime. Lisa's passion and compassion led her to criminal defense allowing her to zealously advocate for those that are accused of a crime.

In addition to her dedication to practicing law, Ms. Wells is an active member of her local legal community. She belongs to the Cobb County Bar Association, is President of Sandy Springs Bar Association, and is a member of the Georgia Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers.
